title: 识字：天地日月
en: Learning characters: sky, earth, sun and moon
intro: Welcome to first grade. Chinese schools start with 识字 (character recognition): pictographs (象形字) that draw the thing itself, then compound ideographs (会意字) that combine pictures into ideas: 日 + 月 = 明 bright, 人 + 木 = 休 rest. Nature words, weather verbs (下雨 · 刮风 · 打雷), opposites, and your first classical rhyming primer.

地.h: Earth 土 + 也: the ground under everything.

空.h: A hollow 穴 dug out by work 工: empty space, the sky.

阳.h: The sun 日 on the hillside 阝: the sunny side (yang).

星.h: Little suns 日 being born 生: stars.

晚.h: The sun 日 + 免: when the sun is gone, late.

风.h: Air swirling inside a sail 几.

雨.h: Raindrops falling from a cloud under the sky line. As a top radical: 雪, 雷, 零.

云.h: A cloud curling up. Traditional 雲 puts 雨 on top.

雷.h: Rain 雨 over rumbling fields 田.

雪.h: Rain 雨 you can sweep with a broom 彐: snow.

刮.h: Tongue 舌 + knife 刂: scrape. Wind scrapes across the land.

打.h: A hand 扌 hammering a nail 丁.

川.h: Three streams flowing side by side.

河.h: Water 氵 + 可 kě for the sound.

江.h: Water 氵 + 工 for the sound.

海.h: Water 氵 + 每 for the sound: the sea every river runs into.

石.h: A rock 口 at the foot of a cliff 厂.

湖.h: Water 氵 + 胡 hú for the sound.

田.h: A field divided into four plots.

禾.h: A grain stalk with its heavy ear bending over.

草.h: Grass 艹 + 早 zǎo for the sound.

花.h: A plant 艹 that transforms 化: it blossoms.

叶.h: Simplified from 葉, leaves 世 on a tree 木.

竹.h: Two bamboo stems with drooping leaves. On top it shrinks to ⺮.

虫.h: A snake or worm with a big head. Radical for small creatures.

蝴.h: Insect 虫 + 胡 hú for the sound.

蝶.h: Insect 虫 + 枼 (thin like a leaf).

青.h: The colour of fresh young plants. Sound part in 请, 晴, 睛, 清.

蛙.h: Creature 虫 + 圭 for the sound: 'wa wa' croaking.

蚂.h: Insect 虫 + 马 mǎ for the sound.

蚁.h: Insect 虫 + 义 yì for the sound: righteous little workers.

足.h: A knee 口 above a foot 止.

明.h: Sun 日 + moon 月: bright. The classic 会意字.

今.h: A roof over the present moment.

昨.h: Sun 日 + 乍 for the sound: the day just gone.

休.h: A person 亻 leaning against a tree 木: rest.

息.h: Breath from the nose 自 and the heart 心.

林.h: Two trees: woods. A common surname.

男.h: Strength 力 in the fields 田: man.

孩.h: Child 子 + 亥 for the sound.

尖.h: Small 小 on top, big 大 below: pointed.

冷.h: Ice 冫 + 令 for the sound.

低.h: A person 亻 bowing low 氐.

长.h: An old man with long flowing hair.

短.h: Measured with an arrow 矢 against a bowl 豆: short.

texts.title: 识字歌（会意字）
texts.src: traditional classroom chant for compound characters

lines.p: rì yuè míng tián lì nán
lines.en: Sun and moon: bright. Field and strength: man.

lines.p: rén mù xiū èr mù lín
lines.en: Person and tree: rest. Two trees: woods.

lines.p: sān mù sēn xiǎo tǔ chén
lines.en: Three trees: forest. Small and earth: dust.

lines.p: bù zhèng wāi xiǎo dà jiān
lines.en: Not straight: crooked. Small over big: pointed.

notes: Each line builds a character from its parts: 不 + 正 = 歪 (crooked), 小 + 土 = 尘 (dust).
Chant it while writing the parts in the air, then the whole character.

texts.title: 对韵歌（笠翁对韵·一东，节选）
texts.src: 李渔 Lǐ Yú (1611–1680), Qing dynasty · public domain

lines.p: tiān duì dì yǔ duì fēng
lines.en: Sky pairs with earth, rain with wind.
lines.mod: 天和地相对，雨和风相对。

lines.p: dà lù duì cháng kōng
lines.en: The great land pairs with the endless sky.

lines.p: shān huā duì hǎi shù
lines.en: Mountain flowers pair with seaside trees,
lines.mod: 山上的花和海边的树相对，

lines.p: chì rì duì cāng qióng
lines.en: the red sun with the blue vault of heaven.
lines.mod: 红红的太阳和蓝蓝的天空相对。

lines.p: léi yǐn yǐn wù méng méng
lines.en: Thunder rumbling faintly, fog hazy and thick.
lines.mod: 雷声隐隐约约，雾气迷迷蒙蒙。

lines.p: rì xià duì tiān zhōng
lines.en: 'Under the sun' pairs with 'mid-heaven'.
lines.mod: 太阳下面和天空中间相对。

lines.p: fēng gāo qiū yuè bái
lines.en: High winds, a white autumn moon;

lines.p: yǔ jì wǎn xiá hóng
lines.en: rain clears, the evening glow turns red.
lines.mod: 雨停了，傍晚的云霞红红的。

notes: 笠翁对韵 is a Qing-dynasty primer that teaches 对仗 (parallel pairing): word against word, same length, opposite or related meaning, contrasting tones. Children chanted it to learn how classical poems are built.
对 duì: to pair with. 苍穹 cāng qióng: the vault of the sky. 隐隐 yǐn yǐn: faint, distant. 霁 jì: rain clearing. 晚霞 wǎn xiá: sunset clouds.
Look at the pairs: 天/地, 雨/风, 山花/海树, 赤日/苍穹, 风高/雨霁, 秋月白/晚霞红.

qs.q: Recite the first line from memory.

texts.title: 画
texts.src: traditionally attributed to 王维 Wáng Wéi (Tang); probably a later riddle poem · public domain

lines.p: yuǎn kàn shān yǒu sè
lines.en: From afar the mountain has colour,
lines.mod: 远远看去，山是有颜色的，

lines.p: jìn tīng shuǐ wú shēng
lines.en: up close the water makes no sound.

lines.p: chūn qù huā hái zài
lines.en: Spring has gone, yet the flowers remain;

lines.p: rén lái niǎo bù jīng
lines.en: people come, yet the birds aren't startled.

notes: It's a riddle: what has silent water, flowers that never fade, and birds that never fly off? A painting 画.
Every line is a pair of opposites: 远/近 far/near, 有/无 have/lack, 去/在 gone/remain, 来/惊 come/startle.
无 wú is the classical word for 没有. 惊 jīng: to be startled.

texts.title: 下雨了

lines.p: tiān shàng yǒu hěn duō hēi yún
lines.en: There are lots of dark clouds in the sky.

lines.p: guā fēng le dǎ léi le xià yǔ le
lines.en: The wind blows, the thunder rolls, it's raining!

lines.p: xiǎo niǎo fēi huí jiā
lines.en: The little birds fly home.

lines.p: xiǎo yú zài hé lǐ yóu lái yóu qù
lines.en: The little fish swim back and forth in the river.

lines.p: qīng wā zài hé yè shàng guā guā jiào
lines.en: The frog croaks on a lotus leaf.

lines.p: xiǎo mǎ yǐ shuō kuài bān jiā
lines.en: The little ants say, 'Quick, move house!'

lines.p: yǔ tíng le tài yáng chū lái le
lines.en: The rain stops and the sun comes out.

lines.p: tiān shàng yǒu yī dào cǎi hóng
lines.en: There's a rainbow in the sky.

notes: Verb + 来 + verb + 去 (游来游去): doing something back and forth.
荷叶 hé yè: lotus leaf. 彩虹 cǎi hóng: rainbow, counted with 道.

qs.q: 下雨的时候，小鸟做什么？
下雨的时候你喜欢做什么？
qs.ans: 下雨的时候我喜欢在家看书。

exercises.why: 反义词 opposites: pairs like these are the backbone of 对韵.
会意字: the meaning comes from combining the parts.
Weather verbs: 下雨, 下雪 · 刮风 · 打雷.
Stars are in the sky: 天上.
去了 = went (done), so it's in the past: 昨天. 今天 today, 明天 tomorrow.
了 marks a completed action, which clashes with 明天. Past: 昨天我去了… Future: 明天我要去…
天空 sky · 白天 daytime · 今天 today.
地上 on the ground · 天地 heaven and earth · 土地 land.
花草 flowers and plants · 红花 red flower · 开花 to bloom.

exercises.p: tiān shàng yǒu hěn duō xīng xing
exercises.en: There are lots of stars in the sky.

models: 下雨的时候我在家看书。

exercises.why: Whole plants: 一棵树, 一棵草.
Single flowers: 一朵花 (also clouds: 一朵云).
Long, winding things: 一条河, 一条路.
A person 亻 leaning against a tree 木: resting.
People and mountains are 高 (tall); rivers, roads, hair are 长 (long).

It's pouring: no sun today. 黑云 dark clouds.

e.en: Off you go, be careful on the way!
